Scripts.OnLeave: MBB_ShowTimeout = 0; if( GameTooltip:IsOwned(self) ) then GameTooltip:Hide(); end

Scripts.OnClick: if not MBB_Options then return; end MBB_Options.ShowTooltip = self:GetChecked() and 1 or 0;

Scripts.OnLoad: if UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth then UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(self, 190); end if UIDropDownMenu_JustifyText then UIDropDownMenu_JustifyText(self, "LEFT"); end -- 3.3.5a fix: no UIDropDownMenu_Initialize here. It runs the init function -- at once, before the SavedVariables are loaded, which made a fresh profile -- store and hid a classic MBB's settings. OnShow initializes it. self:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED"); self:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED");
Scripts.OnShow: if UIDropDownMenu_Initialize then UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(self, MBB_ProfileDropdown_Initialize); end MBB_ProfileDropdown_Refresh();
Scripts.OnEvent: -- 3.3.5a fix: only lock/unlock for combat; a full refresh rewrote whatever menu was open if event == "PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED" then if UIDropDownMenu_DisableDropDown then UIDropDownMenu_DisableDropDown(self); end else if UIDropDownMenu_EnableDropDown then UIDropDownMenu_EnableDropDown(self); end end
